_about: Attunements and keys per Codex instance (tools/lib/codex/attunements.js, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Codex'). Each entry names only its goal (the quests that end the chain, or the key item) and our own one-line note; the steps are built from the Codex's quests (pre, preAny), items (sources) and npcs. `via` names the item a goal item is made from (its drops become the steps; the note says how it is made); `useAt` ({ kind, id }) names the NPC or object standing where `via` is used, which adds a use step there. `onAccept` says the goal quests hand over the item as they are taken (a provided item), so the chain ends at their accept. `open: false` marks a raid Forever has not opened yet, with `openSource` saying how that is known (the Attunements page shows 'Not open on Forever yet' instead of its progress, and the guide's last step says it); remove both once the raid opens. `links` adds a prerequisite our quest data lacks, each with its public source. `inside` places an NPC or object of a chain that has no open-world spawn and that the Codex places in no instance (a quest giver, turn-in or objective inside a dungeon), with its public source. `removed` lists what Forever took out, with the evidence. Sources checked on 2026-11-22 against client build 1.60.1.70532 and the Codex of 1.60.1.70888.

attunements.name: Attunement to the Core
attunements.openSource: Forever's raids at its 9 Dec launch are Onyxia's Lair, The Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit; Molten Core is not open (maintainer, #3695)
attunements.note: Lets Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain send you to the Molten Core; without it, walk in through Blackrock Depths.

attunements.name: Aqual Quintessence
attunements.openSource: Forever's raids at its 9 Dec launch are Onyxia's Lair, The Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit; Molten Core is not open (maintainer, #3695)
attunements.note: Douses the Molten Core's runes; Majordomo Executus comes out only when every rune is doused. Duke Hydraxis hands it out once Hands of the Enemy is done.
sources: https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Aqual_Quintessence (Source: once you complete Hands of the Enemy, Duke Hydraxis gives it)

attunements.name: Blackhand's Command
attunements.openSource: Forever's raids at its 9 Dec launch are Onyxia's Lair, The Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit; Blackwing Lair is not open (maintainer, #3695)
attunements.note: Lets you touch the Orb of Command in Upper Blackrock Spire to reach Blackwing Lair; without it, walk in through the spire.

attunements.name: The Dread Citadel
attunements.openSource: Forever's raids at its 9 Dec launch are Onyxia's Lair, The Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit; Naxxramas is not open (maintainer, #3695)
attunements.note: Everyone entering Naxxramas needs it; which of the three quests you take depends on your standing with the Argent Dawn.

attunements.note: Opens Scholomance's gate; one key opens it for the group.

attunements.name: Shadowforge Key
attunements.note: Opens the Shadowforge gates in Blackrock Depths; one key opens them for the group.

attunements.name: Prison Cell Key
attunements.note: Opens the cells of Blackrock Depths' prison.

attunements.name: Key to the City
attunements.note: Opens the Eastwall Gate into Stratholme's Scourge-held districts.

attunements.name: Crescent Key
attunements.note: Opens the inner doors of Dire Maul's North and West wings.

attunements.name: Workshop Key
attunements.note: Opens Gnomeregan's back door, the Workshop entrance.

attunements.name: The Scarlet Key
attunements.note: Opens the doors of the Armory and the Cathedral.

attunements.name: Dalaran Sewer Key
attunements.note: Opens the gate of the Horde's way into the City of Dalaran; one key opens it for the group. The Image of Archmage Modera gives it with Heart of Disruption: keep that quest in your log until you are inside. The Alliance walks in through the sewer pipe in Cantrips & Crows.

sources.note: provided item: Dalaran Sewer Key (277507), handed over at the accept

attunements.name: Tome of Dalaran
attunements.note: Calls up Lyn the Ignored, a hidden boss, at the summoning circle in the City of Dalaran's Underbelly, in the small room past Atrexis the Grave Knight. The Black Tome lies on a table up the stairs behind Archmage Arugal in Shadowfang Keep; use it at the Ambermill Leyline Focus, the blue crystal beside Archmage Ataeric in Ambermill's town hall, and it becomes the Tome of Dalaran.

sources.note: use: at the Ambermill Leyline Focus

attunements.name: Scepter of Celebras
attunements.note: Opens a portal from the first khan's spot in Maraudon's outer caves to Earth Song Falls in inner Maraudon; the group walks through it. Celebras the Redeemed makes it once Celebras the Cursed is dead inside.

sources.note: use: creates a portal to Earth Song Falls in inner Maraudon

attunements.name: Krol'dok Compound Key
attunements.note: Opens the way into the upper area of Krol'dok Stronghold. Tunk, by the smithy near War Handler Ashka, drops the Krol'dok Moulding; Alphonse Dumas in Farholde Keep forges the key from it with 4 Thick Leather and 12 Iron Bars.
sources: https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/krol-dok-stronghold-quests (Key Ingredients: the key that grants access to the upper area)

attunements.name: Mallet of Zul'Farrak
attunements.note: Rings the gong by the sacred pool in Zul'Farrak to call Gahz'rilla; one mallet does it for the group. Qiaga the Keeper (elite) on top of the Altar of Zul in the Hinterlands drops the Sacred Mallet: use it at the altar at the very top of Jintha'Alor and it becomes the Mallet of Zul'Farrak. Both places are full of elites.

sources.note: 'the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths'
